verdict.rationale: The evidence shows built-in background behaviors: connectors that auto-sync external sources, automatic memory extraction, and automatically maintained user profiles. These are fixed ingestion and sync pipelines, not user-configurable automations or scheduled autonomous tasks. They are adjacent features, so no documented capability lets a user define their own background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
